description: This file defines event management functions for the TestLink project, including declaring events, attaching callbacks, signaling events, and invoking callbacks across plugins. It also references external files and functions related to event handling and plugin management.

methods.name: event_declare
methods.description: Registers a new event with a specified name and type, initializing its callback list in the global cache.

methods.name: event_declare_many
methods.description: Declares multiple events at once based on an array of event names and types.

methods.name: event_hook
methods.description: Attaches a callback function to a specified event, associating it with a plugin.

methods.name: event_hook_many
methods.description: Attaches multiple callbacks to events, optionally handling nested callback arrays.

methods.name: event_clear_callbacks
methods.description: Removes all callbacks from all events in the cache.

methods.name: event_signal
methods.description: Triggers an event, executing all associated callbacks based on event type, and returning the callback output for output events.

methods.name: event_callback
methods.description: Executes a specific callback for an event, optionally handling plugin context.

methods.name: event_type_execute
methods.description: Executes all callbacks associated with an event for create, update, or delete types.

methods.name: event_type_output
methods.description: Executes all callbacks for output type events and compiles their return values into an array.
